method: OpenSCAD F6 source exports; exact-coordinate topology without repair; manifold3d solid Boolean differences/intersections of all 27 independently exported assembly components. Mating surface contact is intentional. Small numeric volume threshold 0.001 mm3. Placement expectations are an independent record of the audited DEFAULT configuration; updating parameters requires updating these expectations.
scope_limitations: No purchased hardware dimensions or physical prints are available. Motors are only conservative generic envelopes, not selected component meshes.
No screw/nut/PCB/battery/cable physical envelopes are certified; tolerance, loads, torque and retention need measured fit tests.
Closed topology and Boolean import do not independently prove absence of every triangle self-intersection; OpenSCAD full solid evaluation and independent Boolean operations provide further evidence.
Slicer/G-code and real printer support/bridging/warping results are not certified.
